description: Implementation of ue_cell_repository class managing UE cells, including adding/removing UEs, handling HARQ timeouts, and related functionalities in a 5G/NR scheduler context.

classes.name: harq_manager_timeout_notifier
classes.description: Handles HARQ timeout notifications and updates metrics accordingly.

methods.name: ue_cell_repository::ue_cell_repository
methods.description: Constructor initializing the UE cell repository with configuration and metrics handler.

methods.name: ue_cell_repository::slot_indication
methods.description: Processes slot indication events to handle HARQ timeouts.

methods.name: ue_cell_repository::deactivate
methods.description: Stops HARQ timers and deactivates the repository.

methods.name: ue_cell_repository::add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE to the repository with configuration, DRX, and optional message slot.

methods.name: ue_cell_repository::rem_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from the repository based on its index.
